title: Replay shows git commits the session never made: vibepet's replay has 19 'Milestone' beats, opens on one and is titled 'Session start'
repro: ⋯ → Theater… → 'Read package.json … · vibepet' (or hover-list ▶ on vibepet)
Read the header; scrub to 1:46 (or step through)
expected: Only vibepet's own events (12 prompts, 12 replies, 1 Read); header = its first prompt; no commits (it made none)
actual: 44 beats incl. 19 commits (483d5e8 … c2b5c0a) made by other processes in the same repo's history during the session's hours (any branch); the first beat is a commit, so the title reads 'Session start' and the stats '19 commits'; 6 of 12 UI spot checks land on these foreign commits
truth: transcript 6101876b: 12 prompts, 12 replies, 1 Read tool call, no Bash/commit; repo log shows the 19 commits authored elsewhere 14:24–16:45 MDT

title: Replay of a live session ends without its live state: kestrel's ends on a prompt while it waits for approval; atlas's ends on './build.sh' with no hint it is still running
repro: Open kestrel's replay (⋯ → Theater…) while its approval dialog is up; click the far right of the scrub bar
Same for beacon while its question is open
expected: The last frame says what the session is doing now: 'waiting for your approval: Bash ./deploy.sh --dry-run (since 6:32 PM)', 'running ./build.sh for 2 min', 'asking: Which database…?'
actual: kestrel: last frame 'PROMPT 06:32 PM · Run exactly ./deploy.sh --dry-run again…', nothing about the open dialog. atlas: 'COMMAND · Run build script · ./build.sh' with an empty terminal, no verdict and no running mark, the same as a finished command with no output. beacon: ends on its prompt
truth: kestrel waiting (permission prompt), pane 'This command requires approval / Do you want to proceed?'; atlas busy with build.sh at batch 14/54; beacon waiting (input needed)

title: AskUserQuestion replays as 'LOOK · AskUserQuestion': the question and its options never appear (beacon: 'Which database should beacon use…? SQLite / Postgres / Redis')
repro: Seek to any AskUserQuestion beat (eye icon)
Click it to open the detail panel
expected: A 'Question' beat with the question text, the options and what the user answered (or that it was dismissed)
actual: Kind 'LOOK' with an eye icon, title 'AskUserQuestion', the rejection text, detail 'output · failed'; the question and options are nowhere in stage, rail or detail
truth: transcript: 12–13 AskUserQuestion calls, each asking 'Which database should beacon use to store check results?' with options SQLite, Postgres, Redis; each dismissed with Esc

title: /loop fires are invisible in a loop session's replay: no marker for 19 scheduled fires; ticks after each resume play under a chapter titled '/exit'

truth: transcript db0c1ec0: 19 scheduled_task_fire records, 26 hidden scheduled prompts, 6 /exit + resume cycles
